realisme.name: Realism
realisme.short: Portraits, mythology, animals, black and grey or colour.
realisme.title: Realism tattoos in Amiens
realisme.metaTitle: Realism tattoo in Amiens: portraits, mythology | Fred-Ink
realisme.metaDesc: Realism tattoos in Amiens at Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio: portraits, animals, Greek and Roman mythology, black and grey or colour. Send us your idea.
realisme.intro: Realism lives on contrast and patience. Portraits, animals, Greek temples and gods, Roman soldiers: every piece is built so the depth still reads ten years on.
body: Realism needs room. A readable portrait is rarely smaller than an open hand, and a mythological scene often takes the whole forearm. The artist will tell you honestly what size suits your idea.
Most pieces take several sessions, spaced out to let the skin heal. The exact number depends on the area and the detail, and is set at the consultation along with the quote.
Bring good references: a sharp, well-lit photo for a portrait, several images for a composition. The artist then draws a version made for your skin and the placement.

floral.name: Floral & ornamental
floral.short: Floral sleeves, mandalas, lace and symmetry.
floral.title: Floral and ornamental tattoos in Amiens
floral.metaTitle: Floral and ornamental tattoo in Amiens, sleeves | Fred-Ink
floral.metaDesc: Floral sleeves, peonies, roses, mandalas and ornaments in Amiens. Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio draws pieces that follow the shape of the arm.
floral.intro: Peonies, roses, lilies, mandalas and lace: pieces drawn to follow the arm from wrist to shoulder, with room to grow later.
body: Good floral work follows the body. Flowers open towards the shoulder, ornaments fall onto the wrist: the design is drawn for the placement, not stuck on like a sticker.
Many sleeves start with a single flower. If you already have the rest in mind, say so: the artist leaves space so the next piece joins on seamlessly.
Black and grey is the most requested, but a touch of colour on the petals works beautifully. We'll talk it through at the consultation.

fineline.name: Fine line
fineline.short: Delicate linework, from wrist to neck.
fineline.title: Fine line tattoos in Amiens
fineline.metaTitle: Fine line tattoo in Amiens | Fred-Ink
fineline.metaDesc: Fine line tattoos in Amiens: butterflies, flowers, sun and moon, small delicate pieces. Honest advice on size so the line ages well.
fineline.intro: Butterflies, flowers, sun and moon, small animals: light, delicate pieces for a first tattoo or to complete a composition.
body: Fine lines age faster than bold ones: ink spreads a little over the years. That's why we may suggest going slightly bigger on a very detailed design. Better to know before.
These pieces are often done in one session. They make great first tattoos, and suit the forearm, shoulder blade or back of the neck.
Lettering, a date, a small symbol? Send the font or an example and the artist will suggest a readable version.

couleur.name: Colour & illustrative
couleur.title: Colour tattoos in Amiens
couleur.metaTitle: Colour, manga and Japanese tattoo in Amiens | Fred-Ink
couleur.metaDesc: Colour tattoos in Amiens: manga, anime, neo-traditional, Japanese sleeves. Saturated colour built to last, at Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio.
couleur.intro: Manga and anime, cartoons, neo-traditional, Japanese sleeves: bold colour and clean outlines for pieces you can read from across the room.
body: Colour lasts when the design is well built: a solid outline, strong contrast, saturated tones. The artist adapts your reference so it stays readable on skin.
Favourite character, a game's universe, a full scene: bring your images. The design is reworked, never just traced.
Large colour pieces take several sessions and regular care, especially in the sun. We'll explain everything at the consultation.

chicano.name: Chicano
chicano.short: Faces, lettering, catrinas, in black and grey.
chicano.title: Chicano tattoos in Amiens
chicano.metaTitle: Chicano tattoo in Amiens, lettering and portraits | Fred-Ink
chicano.metaDesc: Chicano tattoos in Amiens: faces, catrinas, roses, lettering in soft black and grey. Send your idea to Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio.
chicano.intro: Women's faces, catrinas, roses and lettering: chicano in black and grey, with soft gradients and hand-drawn letters.
body: Chicano is all about shading: deep blacks, very gradual greys, and lettering that has to stay readable for years.
A word, a name, a motto? Tell us what it means to you. The artist draws the letters so they belong to the rest of the piece.
Forearm, calf, upper arm: these areas leave enough room to keep the detail.

graphique.name: Graphic
graphique.short: Blackwork, solid black, touches of red.
graphique.title: Graphic and blackwork tattoos in Amiens
graphique.metaTitle: Blackwork and graphic tattoo in Amiens | Fred-Ink
graphique.metaDesc: Blackwork, solid black, sacred hearts, insects and touches of red: graphic tattoos by Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio in Amiens.
graphique.intro: Solid black, clean lines, insects, sacred hearts, a bright red here and there: pieces you read at first glance.
body: Graphic work plays on the contrast between skin and black. Well-packed black stays sharp for a very long time; it's one of the styles that ages best.
A single colour, often red, is enough to make the whole design pop. We'll discuss it depending on your skin and the placement.
These pieces are also a good route for covering an old tattoo: black covers a lot. See the cover-up page.

cover.name: Cover-up
cover.short: Covering or reworking an old tattoo.
cover.title: Tattoo cover-ups in Amiens
cover.metaTitle: Tattoo cover-up in Amiens: cover an old tattoo | Fred-Ink
cover.metaDesc: Tattoo cover-ups and touch-ups in Amiens. Send a photo of your old tattoo and the artist will tell you honestly what's possible.
cover.intro: An old tattoo that isn't you any more, a line that has blurred, a name you want gone: let's look together at what can be covered or reworked.
body: It all starts with a sharp photo of the old tattoo in daylight. From that, the artist can see straight away what's possible and what isn't.
A cover-up is almost always bigger and darker than the original: dark areas, flowers, realism and graphic work suit it well. A very light or fine design won't hide anything.
If the tattoo is very heavy, a few laser sessions can lighten it first. The artist will tell you straight rather than promise a miracle.
Before and after photos of our cover-ups are coming to this page soon.

items.p: It's what clients mention most: the welcome, the good mood in the studio, and artists who take the time to explain.
Prices people find fair, given before anything starts. You know where you stand before the needle touches skin.

piercing.title: Two piercers, and jewellery galore
piercing.lead: Ears, nose, lip, navel: our two piercers fit your jewellery with sterile equipment and walk you through aftercare before you leave.
piercing.jewelsText: A wide choice of jewellery at the studio, for a first piercing or a change later. We'll tell you which materials suit a fresh piercing.
piercing.rdv: Piercings are done at the studio, or by appointment over the phone.
piercing.imageAlt: Daith piercing with an engraved ring and a small ornamental tattoo by the ear
piercing.pageMetaTitle: Piercing in Amiens: ear, nose, lip, navel | Fred-Ink
piercing.pageMetaDesc: Piercing in Amiens at Fred-Ink Tattoo Studio: lobe, helix, daith, nostril, septum, lip, navel. Two piercers, sterile equipment, plenty of jewellery.
careItems: Wash your hands before touching the piercing.
Clean once or twice a day with the product recommended at the studio, without twisting the jewellery.
Avoid pools, the sea and baths for the first few weeks.
Don't change the jewellery before it has healed: drop by and we'll do it with you.
piercing.healing: Healing takes from a few weeks for a lobe to several months for cartilage or a navel.

steps.p: The online form: your idea, placement, size and references. Or drop by the studio.

steps.t: The artist gets back to you
steps.p: By phone or email, to ask the right questions and tell you what's doable.
We refine the design together and set the price, length and date of the session.
The stencil is checked on your skin before we start. Ask for a break whenever you like.
You leave with aftercare instructions. A question while it heals? Call us.

hygiene.title: Clean, no discussion

items.p: Needles, cartridges, gloves, covers: everything that touches skin is new, opened in front of you and thrown away after the session.
The station is disinfected and covered with fresh film between every client.
Inks that comply with current European regulations for tattooing.
In France, tattooers and piercers must complete hygiene training and declare their activity to the regional health agency.

hygiene.note: Curious about the equipment? Ask and we'll show you.

items: Sleep well and eat before you come.
No alcohol the day before or on the day.
Moisturise the area in the days before, and avoid sunburn.
Wear clothes that leave the area easy to reach.
Keep the film on for as long as the artist says.
Wash gently with lukewarm water and mild soap, pat dry.
Apply a thin layer of the recommended cream two or three times a day.
Don't scratch or pick at small scabs.
Allow two to four weeks for the surface of the skin.
No pools, sea, baths or sauna during that time.
Keep it out of the sun, then use high SPF all year round.
A touch-up is sometimes useful: we'll talk about it once the skin has fully healed.

studio.title: Nineteen years on rue du Général Leclerc
text: Fred-Ink has been tattooing and piercing Amiens for nineteen years. What started around Fred has grown into a team of eight tattooers and two piercers, each with their own style.
Every now and then we open the doors for a studio night: piercing and jewellery offers, a prize draw, a drink. Dates are announced on Instagram.

infos.accessText: On rue du Général Leclerc in Amiens. Come on foot, by bus or by bike; if you drive, park in the nearby streets.
infos.rdv: Appointments in person, by phone, or through the project form.

items.q: How much does a tattoo cost?
items.a: The price depends on size, placement, detail and the number of sessions. You get it before anything starts, at the consultation. Send your idea with a rough budget and the artist will tell you what's possible.
A deposit may be asked to hold your session date; it's then taken off the final price. The amount comes with the quote.

items.q: I'm under 18, can I get tattooed?
items.a: In France, tattooing or piercing a minor requires written consent from a parent or legal guardian, who comes with you with their ID. The artist may turn down some designs or placements before 18.

items.q: Do you do cover-ups and touch-ups?
items.a: Yes. For a cover-up, send a sharp photo of the old tattoo and the artist will tell you honestly what can be covered. For a touch-up on a piece done at the studio, give us a call.
A little, and it depends on the area: ribs, feet or the inner arm are more sensitive than the shoulder or forearm. We take breaks whenever you need.
From under an hour for a small piece to several hours for a large one. Sleeves are done over several sessions, a few weeks apart.
Drop by to talk about your idea or a piercing; tattoo sessions are by appointment. The easiest way: the online form, or a call.
